title: 第19章 杨先生第20章 断了脊梁的老狗
slug: 老乡你咋还会搓火球嘞
content_zh:
“吁——！吁——！”
“绝哥儿！快让它停下！再往前就要翻沟里了！我这把老骨头可折腾不起啊！”
“吁！吁！！吁——！！！”
夕阳、田间、土路、疾驰的毛驴、飞扬的尘土、挥鞭的张绝和绝望的老刘头。
“这驴疯了！”张绝骂道，“肯定是你个老抠门中午没让它吃饱！我说了这样的钱不能省，它拉了我们一天，得给它喂精饲料！精饲料！！”
他猛拉缰绳，却根本无法控制驴子嘶吼着向前。
最终，只听见“噗通”一声，那发狂的驴子带着平板车一起翻进了田间的沟渠中。
张绝满是淤泥，狼狈地提溜着老刘头的后衣领，费力从沟渠里爬了出来。
成为散星法师后，术法如何另说，他的身体素质到底和之前不一样了，张绝除了看起来有些潦草狼狈外，身上并没有因此受什么伤。
老刘头可就惨了，他本来就瘸着一条腿没好，如今再被摔这一下，整个人都七荤八素的，自己怎么被张绝从沟里救出来都不知道。
掉进沟里的驴还在“嗯啊嗯啊”的哀嚎，张绝和老刘头却没心情去管它了。
两人喘着粗气小心翼翼地躺在田边的草地上，生怕压到田里刚长出来的麦苗。
“好好的一头驴车啊！”等老刘头缓过劲来后，他第一时间心疼的却不是自己，而是那辆花钱租来的驴车，“这下那押金肯定是要不回来了！”
张绝没理会他的哭丧，从草地上坐起来，先去看了一眼那头已经被摔断了腿的疯驴，确定这头驴没救了之后，他呼喊招来了一个原本在田间忙碌，刚看到这边热闹的农夫。
农夫过来后，他又是一顿唾沫横飞，讨价还价，将那头断腿的驴就地贱卖出去，接着让农夫帮忙从沟里将还算结实，没有散架的板车救上来。
这边的老刘头还在哭嚎，那边张绝已经把他重新拉上了板车，自己则从原本的车夫变成现在充当驴的角色，拉着老刘头继续沿着田垄之间向前走。
老刘头回过神来后，才愣愣地发现，张绝已经解决了所有麻烦，他们就像什么意外都没发生一样，继续赶路了。
“唉。”
听到后面的叹气声，张绝不由得翻了个白眼。
“你有什么可叹气的？”

老刘头遗憾道。
“我是在可惜，我居然没个女儿，不然我肯定招你当女婿。”
“算了吧，天天看着你这张脸，我实在想不出你要是有闺女，她能长什么样。”
“哎——年轻时候的我，也是风流倜傥！”
“快别侮辱这个词了。”
两人拌着嘴赶路，倒也不觉得时间过得慢。
他们抵达彭城后，才知道那位教书的杨先生居然早就不教书了，反而在当地开起了一家纺织工厂，当起了实业家！
现如今他也年长，家里的生意全都交给小辈去操持，自己则在乡下老家盖了间茅屋，安度晚年去了。
于是两人又从彭城出来，一路赶到了乡下。
好在毛驴翻车的地方距离杨先生的茅屋已经不远，张绝拉着老刘头走了大概一个多小时，终于来到了这座名为杨杏的村子。
又浪费了一会时间问路，最终在村子西北角的银杏林中，他们找到了那位杨先生。
张绝和老刘头他们来时，已经到了晚上7点多钟，农村人休息的早，这个时候早就有不少人家准备睡了。
而那位估摸着有九十多岁高龄的杨先生，此时居然还没睡，而是坐在茅屋外的躺椅上，身上盖着一张厚毛毯，吹着夜风看星星。
这是一个须发皆白的老人，他听到动静声，眯着眼睛盯着一身淤泥的张绝和老刘头看了好一会儿，才突然冒出一句。
“那个混账酒鬼呢？”
content_en:
"Uu——! Uu——!"
"Brother Jue! Stop it quickly! If you go any further, you'll end up in a ditch! My old bones can't handle it!"
"Uu! Uu! Uu-!!!"
The setting sun, fields, dirt roads, galloping donkeys, flying dust, whip-cracking Zhang Jue and desperate old Liu Tou.
"This donkey is crazy!" Zhang Jue scolded, "You must be a stingy old man who didn't let it eat enough at noon! I said we can't save money like this. It has been with us for a day, so we have to feed it concentrate feed! Concentrate feed!!"
He jerked on the reins, but couldn't control the donkey's roaring forward.
In the end, there was only a "plop" sound, and the crazy donkey and the flatbed truck rolled over into the ditch in the field.
Zhang Jue was covered in mud, and he held Lao Liutou by the back of his collar in an embarrassed manner, and struggled to climb out of the ditch.
After becoming a Sanxing mage, apart from his magic skills, his physical quality was different from before. Apart from Zhang Jue looking a little sloppy, he did not suffer any injuries from this.
Old Liu Tou was in dire straits. He was already lame on one leg, but now that he was thrown again, his whole body was in a state of disrepair. He didn't even know how he was rescued from the ditch by Zhang Jue.
The donkey that fell into the ditch was still wailing "ah ah ah", but Zhang Jue and Lao Liu Tou were not in the mood to care about it.
Panting heavily, the two lay down carefully on the grass at the edge of the field, for fear of crushing the wheat seedlings that had just grown in the field.
"What a great donkey cart!" After Old Liu Tou regained his composure, the first thing he felt distressed was not himself, but the rented donkey cart. "The deposit will definitely not be returned now!"
Zhang Jue ignored his cries and sat up from the grass. He first took a look at the crazy donkey whose leg had been broken. After confirming that the donkey was hopeless, he called out to a farmer who was busy in the fields and had just seen the excitement here.
After the farmer came over, he spat again, bargained, and sold the donkey with a broken leg at a low price. Then he asked the farmer to help rescue the cart that was still strong and not falling apart from the ditch.
Here, Old Liu Tou is still crying, but over there, Zhang Jue has pulled him back onto the cart. He has changed from the original driver to the role of donkey, pulling Old Liu Tou to continue walking forward between the fields.
After Lao Liu came back to his senses, he was stunned to find that Zhang Jue had solved all the troubles. They continued on their way as if nothing unexpected had happened.
"Alas."
Hearing the sigh from behind, Zhang Jue couldn't help but roll his eyes.
"What do you have to sigh about?"
Old Liu Tou said regretfully.
"It's a pity that I don't have a daughter, otherwise I would definitely recruit you as my son-in-law."
"Forget it, looking at your face every day, I really can't imagine what you would look like if you had a daughter."
"Hey - when I was young, I was also very charming!"
"Stop using that insulting word."
The two of them chatted and hurried on, but they didn't feel that time was passing slowly.
After they arrived in Pengcheng, they learned that the teacher, Mr. Yang, had actually stopped teaching a long time ago. Instead, he opened a local textile factory and became an industrialist!
Now that he is older, all the family business is left to his juniors, while he builds a hut in his hometown in the countryside and spends his remaining years in peace.
So the two came out of Pengcheng again and rushed all the way to the countryside.
Fortunately, the place where the donkey overturned was not far from Mr. Yang's thatched hut. Zhang Jue took Lao Liutou and walked for more than an hour, and finally arrived at the village called Yangxing.
After wasting a while to ask for directions, they finally found Mr. Yang in the ginkgo forest in the northwest corner of the village.
When Zhang Jue and Lao Liutou arrived, it was already past 7 o'clock in the evening. Rural people went to bed early, and many people were already ready to go to bed at this time.
And Mr. Yang, who was estimated to be in his nineties, was not asleep at this time, butSitting on a deck chair outside the hut, covered with a thick blanket, watching the stars in the night breeze.
This was an old man with white hair and beard. When he heard the noise, he squinted his eyes and stared at Zhang Jue and Lao Liu who were covered in mud for a long time before he suddenly said something.
"Where's that bastard drunkard?"
